claims: Kyler Murray has signed a one-year contract with the Minnesota Vikings for the 2026 season.
The contract is worth the veteran minimum of $1.3 million.
Kyler Murray was released by the Arizona Cardinals.
Kyler Murray is guaranteed $36.8 million in 2026 from his previous contract with Arizona.
The deal includes a no-tag clause.
The Cardinals released Murray, triggering the massive guaranteed salary.
The Cardinals' release of Murray allowed him to sign elsewhere for the minimum.
In 2022, Kyler Murray signed a five-year, $230.5 million extension with the Cardinals.
The 2022 extension included $160 million in guaranteed money.
